requirements.quote:
The DNS assumes that messages will be transmitted as datagrams or in a
byte stream carried by a virtual circuit.
requirements.required_behavior: Transmit messages as datagrams or as a byte stream carried by a virtual circuit.
requirements.why_checkable: The transport interface can be checked for datagram delivery or byte-stream delivery over a virtual circuit.

requirements.quote:
While virtual circuits can be
used for any DNS activity, datagrams are preferred for queries due to
their lower overhead and better performance.
requirements.required_behavior: A virtual circuit may be used to carry the activity; this is permission, not a requirement to select a virtual circuit.
requirements.why_checkable: An implementation transport-selection path can be inspected to determine whether its choice of a virtual circuit is permitted for the activity.

requirements.quote:
While virtual circuits can be
used for any DNS activity, datagrams are preferred for queries due to
their lower overhead and better performance.
requirements.condition: When choosing a transport for DNS queries
requirements.required_behavior: Prefer datagrams for queries as an advisory transport choice; virtual circuits remain permitted.
requirements.why_checkable: The default query transport and transport-selection policy can be inspected to assess the datagram preference without treating alternatives as prohibited.

requirements.quote:
Zone refresh activities
must use virtual circuits because of the need for reliable transfer.
requirements.required_behavior: Use virtual circuits for zone refresh activities.
requirements.why_checkable: The transport selected by the zone-refresh path can be inspected or observed during a refresh.

requirements.quote:
The Internet supports name server access using TCP [RFC-793] on server
port 53 (decimal) as well as datagram access using UDP [RFC-768] on UDP
port 53 (decimal).
requirements.condition: For Internet name-server access using TCP
requirements.why_checkable: The server listening port or client destination port for DNS over TCP can be inspected or observed.

requirements.quote:
The Internet supports name server access using TCP [RFC-793] on server
port 53 (decimal) as well as datagram access using UDP [RFC-768] on UDP
port 53 (decimal).
requirements.condition: For Internet name-server datagram access using UDP
requirements.why_checkable: The server listening port or client destination port for DNS over UDP can be inspected or observed.
